title: NHL in Spain 2025: How to Watch & Stream
text:
NHL Fans in Spain Gain Exclusive Access to Games via DAZN in 2025
DAZN will become the exclusive international home of the National Hockey League (NHL) for fans in Spain beginning in the 2025 season, offering live games, playoff coverage, and additional content through a new partnership. The move streamlines access for spanish viewers, integrating the former NHL.TV service directly into the DAZN platform.
A New Era for NHL Streaming in Spain
spanish hockey enthusiasts are set to benefit from a meaningful shift in how they access NHL content. According to a company release, DAZN will broadcast all matches of the regular NHL season and the Stanley Cup Playoffs, alongside supplementary material like game summaries, highlights, and dedicated programs. This access can be obtained either as a standalone subscription or as an addition to an existing DAZN plan.
The most notable change is the consolidation of NHL.TV directly within the DAZN app, eliminating the need for a separate subscription. This approach mirrors DAZN’s existing strategy with the NFL Game Pass International, presenting the competition as a dedicated channel within the broader platform.
Subscription Options and Pricing
DAZN is offering a range of subscription tiers to cater to different viewing preferences and budgets. The available options include:
- Monthly Subscription: €22.99
- Season Pass: €119.99
- Ultimate Monthly Subscription: €27.99
- Season Pass Ultimate: €134.99
The Ultimate plan provides enhanced features, including access from multiple devices, a “multiview” function allowing simultaneous viewing of up to four games, and a 15% discount code for official NHL merchandise at Shop.international.nhl.com.
Free Access and Seamless Transition
DAZN will also offer a free weekly NHL game through its free tier, providing a taste of the action for those not wishing to commit to a paid subscription.
Existing NHL.TV subscribers will experience a smooth transition. One analyst noted that users will receive a personalized email with a link to set up their new DAZN account using their current email address. Alternatively, they can directly access NHL.TV content within DAZN using their existing credentials.
